in_marathi.name: Ahalyana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahalyana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahalyana is the name of a legendary figure from Indian mythology. She is often described as a radiant or luminous goddess, revered for her wisdom and compassion. Ahalyana is the wife of Gautama Rishi and is also known as Savitri, the savior of her husband from the clutches of death.
